headline: The plaza remembers
lede: GRIND CITY keeps what it used to lose: a line that banked letters but died inside two seconds still plays back — badged NEAR MISS — and after you leave, the attract screen re-rides your best run behind the title instead of idling.

notes.text: Near-miss law: a run earns its replay if it skated 2 s OR banked at least one S-K-A-T-E letter, with a NEAR MISS — LETTERS COUNT badge on the short one — the fail that teaches instead of the fail that vanishes.

Attract remembers: the session's best line (score, then letters, then newer) banks its seed and pad log, the plaza re-simulates it under the title card, wraps at its own end, and a BEST LINE chip says it out loud; a first visit still gets the bot's line.

grindcheck ALL GREEN with 13/13 mutants dead (three new: nearmiss, bestline, bankline); the live drive proves n=88 near replay, badge pixels, bot fallback, seed-7 re-ride and a stall-free loop — sim rules and the determinism spine untouched.

A re-sim loop must wrap on its own terms: how the run ENDED isn't in the pads, so the attract loop keys its wrap off the pad-log length, not the sim — the first live run rode 778 ticks before confessing.
